payload.acceptance_criteria:
When gh cannot read a just-dispatched run yet, then the landing keeps waiting up to the 15 min limit and refuses only then, naming that gh could not read it.
When quality-gates already has a failed or cancelled run for the head, or for an earlier head of the lane with the same tree outside the ledger, then the landing refuses before any push or dispatch and names that run.
When a lane changed after a failed run, then the next attempt pushes a new land/LANE/N branch.
When merge_worktree runs with mode ci, then it merges on the CI proof without a local full verify, and a refused proof or failing local-only checks land nothing.
When the landed base stays unverified or unpushed or a land/ branch stays, then the command exits 1 with a note.
The worktree-isolation skill and its lifecycle reference and the harness-loop operations reference say when to use --mode ci, the fallback --mode full, the land/ branches, the first-attempt rule and the preconditions.
